title: close --summary credits a goal clause to a bug filed from the story that carried it, because the bug's title mirrors the clause
goal: Found at the SP-x5gjv4r7 close: goal_clause_lines (bl_land.py) names the one done item whose title and goal hold the largest share of a clause's words, so clause 3 ('precheck maps each goal clause to the check that reads it ...') was credited to BG-bgnkzjzt, a usage-text bug the ST-ylje2dxh worker filed, not to ST-ylje2dxh, which delivered the clause; the close commit's delivered-by list then names the follow-up. run:
